subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should OpenClaw standardize provider-owned live catalog refresh for OpenRouter and configured OpenAI-compatible providers, and what catalog visibility, cache scope, and metadata-trust rules should become the supported contract?
rationale: The remaining choices affect credentials, tenant isolation, cost and capability safety, picker defaults, offline behavior, and plugin API direction; automation cannot infer the intended product contract.

options.title: Standardize provider refresh
options.body: Adopt provider-owned live catalog hooks with credential-scoped caching, bounded picker views, `provider/*` allowlists, and conservative metadata fallbacks.

options.title: Limit to OpenRouter
options.body: Implement only an OpenRouter-owned live catalog and leave generic configured-provider discovery in its separate tracker.

options.title: Keep catalogs explicit
options.body: Retain static or manually configured catalogs and require dynamic behavior to come from provider-specific external plugins.

recommendation.title: Standardize provider refresh
recommendation.body: Adopt provider-owned live catalog hooks with credential-scoped caching, bounded picker views, `provider/*` allowlists, and conservative metadata fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline routes the cross-provider product decision here, and this account has recent involvement in provider architecture decisions.
